data_as_of: Pre-market quotes from StockAnalysis.com quote API (~7:35–7:51 a.m. CT Nov 20) cross-checked with Yahoo Finance v7/screener (~7:40–7:50 a.m. CT); futures, VIX, 10Y, DXY, oil, gold ~7:34–7:40 a.m. CT and Bitcoin ~7:49 a.m. CT (Yahoo). Prior closes are Thursday Nov 19.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures down ~2.2% and VIX above 31 as the AI selloff spreads globally a day after Anthropic's debut; Anthropic −12% pre-market, Intuit −10% on its Mailchimp sale and outlook.
drivers: Futures are falling again after Thursday's broad ~2% drop, with Nasdaq-100 futures off ~2.2% and the VIX above 31, its highest since March per CNBC. Anthropic's debut failed to lift the AI trade: the stock reversed its 17% first-day gain and is down ~12% pre-market (still above the $83 IPO price), and the selling spread overnight to Asia and Europe — Nikkei −5.1%, Kospi −5.2%, Taiex −5.65% (on track for its worst week since 1997), SoftBank −14.5%, Tokyo Electron −7%, ASML −5.8%. US chip names (AMD, TSM, UMC, ASX, MU) are down 3–9%, while staples, health care and India ADRs are firmer. Safe-haven buying pushed the 10-year yield below 5% (~4.98%); gold (−3.4%) and Bitcoin (−3.5%) are also lower. On earnings, Intuit (−10%) is selling Mailchimp and guided Credit Karma lower, Ross (−6%) gave soft Q4 EPS guidance, BJ's (−6%) fell despite raising its outlook, and BILL agreed to a $63.25/share buyout by TPG and Corpay. Fed Governors Waller and Cook speak today; it is also monthly options expiration.

notes: Run started 7:48 a.m. CT; session = PRE-MARKET. Movers use live pre-market quotes vs Thursday's close.

Mac browser worked (WebFetch not used). Universe: Yahoo v1 screener of 2,018 exchange-listed US stocks (OTC excluded) with price > $5 and market cap > $2B; 1,003 had a pre-market quote in the last hour. Pre-market price, % and volume then taken from the StockAnalysis quote API for ~270 names (top/bottom 45 Yahoo pre-market movers plus the 200 names with the highest 10-day average volume) plus 16 leveraged ETFs and proxies.

Quality movers require at least 10K pre-market shares on StockAnalysis. Left out for that reason: ESE (+5.4%, 229 shares), BKE (+2.9%, 2.7K), FMS (+2.8%, 6.2K), HUM (+2.5%, 4.7K), BRO (+2.3%, 6.9K), BKD (+9.3% on 3 shares).

Rel vol (all tables) = pre-market volume ÷ 3-month average daily volume, a time-of-day fraction, not a full-session ratio. ANT has no meaningful average (one day of trading), so its rel vol is null. Leveraged vol_vs_avg = pre-market volume ÷ 10-day average volume (30-day not available).
Most active (shares and dollars) covers only the ~270 stocks quoted on StockAnalysis, not a full-market scan; ETFs are excluded from those lists.

Gap screen applied strictly: only BJ and BILL pass. Most 3%+ gappers are sector/AI selloff moves without a company catalyst of a listed type; INTU, BLTE, ROST, MOG-A and GAP have catalysts but under 100K pre-market shares at ~7:50 a.m. CT.

SNDK: Yahoo's prior close field shows $755.16 while both sources compute the pre-market move (~−6.7%) against ~$94.40, which suggests a share-split adjustment; SNDK was not in the top-10 tables, and the % shown in notes uses the adjusted basis.

Under-$5 lists from StockAnalysis pre-market gainers/losers (top 20 each, exchange-listed, no OTC), pre-market volume ≥ 100K; only 8 gainers met that bar. Float was not retrieved this run (n/a). News checked via Yahoo Finance headlines; reverse-split history over 90 days was not checked beyond announced splits (PARA, CYAB).

Bitcoin change is Yahoo's 24-hour change. Intuit guidance: StockTitan says FY operating income/EPS view kept and Credit Karma growth cut to 3–7%; Benzinga says FY27 sales guide was cut below estimates.
Flash PMI time not verified for today. Moog's results details were not reviewed (8-K dated Nov 20 confirms release). No unusual-options source was available.
No git commands were run; the Mac publish agent handles commit and push.
